user_prompt:
Jo has three metal blocks. The weight of each block is the same.
When she weighed one block against 8 grams, this is what happened.

[Image: The block is lighter than the weight of 8 grams on the scale.]

When she weighed all three blocks against 20 grams, this is what happened.

[Image: The three blocks are heavier than the weight of 20 grams on the scale.]

Which of the following could be the weight of one metal block?

Figure, described in words:
Two balance scale diagrams:
- Top balance scale: The beam is tilted down to the right. On the higher left pan rests one gray rectangular metal block. On the lower right pan rest four weights: one large weight labeled "5g" and three small weights stacked beside it, each labeled "1g" (total 8 grams).
- Bottom balance scale: The beam is tilted down to the left. On the lower left pan rests a stack of three identical gray rectangular metal blocks. On the higher right pan rest two large weights, each labeled "10g" (total 20 grams).

A. 5 g
B. 6 g
C. 7 g
D. 8 g

answer.description: The letter of the option you choose for the question.
